findings.summary: Snapshot status 'parsed' differs from live 'published' for the retained run; status equality would refuse the real state.
findings.resolution: D3 rule 6 compares run_id and parsed_at exactly and requires status in parsed/published (publication does not reparse).

findings.summary: Initial claim that OLD parses only succeeded+unparsed runs is false: autopipe recompute reparses published runs (#1789).
findings.resolution: Rule 6 rests on unconditional parsed_at=now() in the OLD parse transaction (a8db554d parser.py parse_run/mark_run_parsed), verified in source.

findings.summary: A run_key probe on the OLD store decompresses every compressed chunk (EXPLAIN on production).
findings.resolution: Retained discovery is a loose index scan on the rollback primary key; no OLD-store scan.

findings.summary: Reverse recovery accepted any non-OLD canonical OID; after reattach it must be the admitted narrow OID.
findings.resolution: D6 pins canonical to narrow_oid in reforward mode.
